information:
Se vai competir pela primeira vez, certifique-se de ler todas as informações em [Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlterdoChaoOpen2025#54420-perguntas-frequentes-faq) e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Também poderá assistir a este [tutorial](https://youtu.be/EIdO91rkNDM).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlterdoChaoOpen2025#54425-associados-aps-aps-associates).

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlterdoChaoOpen2025#54420-perguntas-frequentes-faq) and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
You can also watch this [tutorial](https://youtu.be/EIdO91rkNDM).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlterdoChaoOpen2025#54425-associados-aps-aps-associates).
